landing_text: A willow's whisper, a wisp's lantern, and the quiet pull of Fluxia.$(br2)This grimoire records the rites, tools and sigils of the Wisp & Willow tradition — what each thing costs, what it gives back, and how to draw the circle so the altar will actually answer.
name: Wisp & Willow Grimoire
subtitle: Rites, Sigils & Currents
